    n = int(input().strip())
    arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    k = int(input().strip())
    
    arr.sort()
    
    best = 1
    for i in range(n):
        count = 1
        for j in range(i + 1, n):

                count += 1
            else:
                break
        if count > best:
            best = count
    
    print(best)

    main()
